dwarfLessonIntro->Upon the anvil of Grugni, these legends were forged:
dwarfLessonIntro->Carried through the ages by Olituv, these scrolls tell:
dwarfLessonIntro->May the hand and anvil of Forgram teach you this:
dwarfLessonIntro->For Belhjorn's words rings across the heavens and stars:
dwarfLessonIntro->With the strike of each pick, Mahal heeds:
dwarfLessonIntro->Tomkar's freezing embrace kills and maims, but it also heeds:
dwarfLessonIntro->Through Uhjit's vile sins, we spread the word:
dwarfLessonIntro->In the rock womb of Lugar's realm, she tells us all:
dwarfLessonReinforcement->For Grugni's beard blesses us.
dwarfLessonReinforcement->With your efforts, the forge burns bright.
dwarfLessonReinforcement->With your strength, the mine grows larger.
dwarfLessonReinforcement->With your cry, the hall grows joyful.
dwarfLessonReinforcement->Forgram carves into the worldblade your name.
dwarfLessonReinforcement->The strength of Belhjorn upholds those who do good.
dwarfLessonReinforcement->May Tomkar's frost bring us closer..
lessonReinforcement->And so the tale will live on.
